scope: Isolated local Chrome with own remote-origin fixture; no TV, real player or media

checks.name: Collaps is preferred over API-first Alloha when no preference is saved
Init is loading, controls are disabled, and bridged iframe is inert/out of tab order
Ready differs from playing; play uses an object command and waits for acknowledgement
Pause label/state change only after native-shaped state3 acknowledgement
±10 second controls send separate absolute seeks, clamp boundaries, and display only acknowledged position
Buffering preserves each focused transport button, ignores OK until ready and never steals deliberate Back/browser focus
Replay clears stale ended state on state2 without optional ended:false and the next OK pauses
Wrong origin, sibling source and nonnumeric media fields cannot spoof UI state
D-pad, Tab and programmatic iframe focus remain in parent controls
TV-shaped Back10009 removes iframe and returns to the selected provider
Changing translation resets state and rejects events from the removed frame
First iframe load preserves valid ready/state messages received before its load event
Repeated same-origin iframe navigation resets stale state/time/commands and starts a fresh readiness deadline
Other providers retain their explicit unverified fallback and saved preference overrides default Collaps
